ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) ventral surface with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution corresponding to localized scarring.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark base with discrete, high-contrast white linear segments and circular focal spots scattered across both lobes, with a higher concentration of white pixels in the central region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 45-50 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge boundary with high-amplitude serrations and significant tissue erosion, particularly pronounced and jagged on the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the central notch to the tips, characterized by an irregular and broken outer boundary trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense distribution of small, roughly circular white pixel clusters (2-10 pixel diameters) representing barnacle attachment sites across the entire visible surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of distinct, intersecting white linear pixel streaks (rake marks) concentrated on the left lobe and extending through the central fluke area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks across the entire ventral surface and severe irregular trauma/notching along the trailing edges, indicating significant environmental or predatory interactions.
other_distinctive_markers: Severely jagged and 'saw-toothed' trailing edge profile with a notable chunk missing from the upper-left distal tip.
